name: office180
description: Markdown-first Word authoring and Vector180-first PowerPoint authoring with strict, reviewable Office round trips.

interface.shortDescription: Author reviewable Word and PowerPoint branches.
interface.longDescription: Creates Word documents from canonical Markdown and PowerPoint presentations from deterministic, no-reflow Vector180 SVG atoms, then diagnoses and reconciles supported Office edits.
defaultPrompt: Create a polished Word report from canonical Markdown.
Build an editable PowerPoint from Vector180 SVG atoms.
Reconcile my supported Word or PowerPoint edits.
